name: book-site
description: book.semirov.dev — the book, written in public

scripts.build: npm run build -w @book/shared && npm run build -w @book/server && npm run build -w @book/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @book/shared && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run arch && npm run test
